analysis.rationale: This candidate contains no verifiable facts, no primary-source evidence, no URLs, and no executable claims. It is a meta-statement from the researcher announcing an intention to verify a 'strong signal set' that is never specified. There is zero trigger sourcing, zero corroborating sourcing, and only two internal context sources. The suggested process match (geopolitical-technology-control) is unsubstantiated and cannot be meaningfully updated without any concrete fact. Nothing here changes the user's understanding of the world; it is a placeholder at best and should not consume this cycle's single Global Insight. Verification must wait for actual evidence to arrive.
